zrh-terminal.name: Zurich Airport, Arrivals
zrh-terminal.what: Four land here Friday at 20:30 and the fifth at 06:30 on Saturday. Back once more on the 13th, at the terminal by 08:45.

kloten-hotel.name: Kloten, the airport hotel
kloten-hotel.what: The Zleep on the first night, booked. The 11th and 12th are still open, and five people will not fit in two Zleep rooms.

zrh-rental.name: Rental Centre, Airport Center Level 1
zrh-rental.what: The 7-seat VW Caddy is collected here at 09:00 on Saturday and is due back at noon on Friday the 11th.

zug-altstadt.name: Zug, the old town and the lakefront
zug-altstadt.what: Late morning on the way south. Flat, paved and full of benches, with the Zytturm to look at and the Kirschtorte to eat.

schwyz-town.name: Schwyz, the Historical apartment
schwyz-town.what: Booked, 5-7 September. Self check-in by key box at 16:00. Brunnen is five minutes, Weggis about thirty, Lucerne forty-five.

brunnen-quay.name: Brunnen quay
brunnen-quay.what: Five minutes from the apartment, where the lake turns the corner into the Urnersee. The view on all the old posters.

weggis-village.name: Weggis
weggis-village.what: Half an hour round the lake from Schwyz. Park at the pier - CHF 13 for 24 hours, and it is not free.

weggis-cablecar.name: Weggis cable-car station
weggis-cablecar.what: Luftseilbahn Weggis-Rigi Kaltbad. Check the board: a Sunday timetable is not a weekday one.

rigi-kaltbad.name: Rigi Kaltbad
rigi-kaltbad.what: Change from the cable car to the cogwheel. The 4 km walk down from Kulm ends here.

rigi-kanzeli.name: Kanzeli viewpoint
rigi-kanzeli.what: The easy one for the parents. Paved, level, straight out over the lake.

rigi-kulm.name: Rigi Kulm
rigi-kulm.what: 1,798 m. Queen of the Mountains, and exposed - take a layer even if Weggis is warm.

weggis-pier.name: Weggis boat pier
weggis-pier.what: SGV boats into Lucerne. The van sits here all day, which is what makes the evening crossing work.

lucerne-pier.name: Lucerne, Bahnhofquai pier
lucerne-pier.what: The boat arrives beside the station. Last one back leaves at 19:12 and reaches Weggis at 19:53.

lucerne-kapellbrucke.name: Kapellbrücke, Lucerne
lucerne-kapellbrucke.what: The covered wooden bridge, 1365. Five minutes on foot from the pier, and best in the early evening.

lungern-lakeside.name: Lungern, Obsee
lungern-lakeside.what: Park in the Obsee car park - 222 spaces, CHF 5 for 24 hours - not the tight unmarked bend at Chälrütirank.

lungern-turren.name: Turren, above Lungern
lungern-turren.what: Ten minutes by cable car to a terrace facing the Bernese Alps across the lake. Every 20 minutes, and the last one DOWN on a weekday is 17:00.

meiringen.name: Meiringen
meiringen.what: Fifteen minutes off the Brünig road, and the reason to come off it.

aareschlucht-west.name: Aareschlucht West
aareschlucht-west.what: Go in from this end. Free parking that takes a van, and the first half to mid-gorge is level, railed and wheelchair-passable.

aareschlucht-ost.name: Aareschlucht Ost
aareschlucht-ost.what: The far end, 1.4 km and about 45 minutes through. There is a train back one stop if legs have had enough.

grindelwald-village.name: Grindelwald
grindelwald-village.what: Base for four nights, 7-11 September. Not booked yet: Chalet Adelheid leads at CHF 1,356, five minutes from the Terminal.

grindelwald-terminal.name: Grindelwald Terminal
grindelwald-terminal.what: Five minutes from the apartment, or bus 121, free on the guest card. First Eiger Express at 08:00.

eigergletscher.name: Eigergletscher
eigergletscher.what: Fifteen minutes up on the Eiger Express, then change to the cog railway into the mountain. The Eiger Trail starts here on the way down.

jungfraujoch.name: Jungfraujoch, Top of Europe
jungfraujoch.what: 3,454 m, the highest railway station in Europe. The seat reservation is mandatory and altitude sickness is common: go slow.

lauterbrunnen.name: Lauterbrunnen
lauterbrunnen.what: Park at the station, CHF 18 for the day. Neither the operator nor the garage publishes a height limit, so measure the van first.

grutschalp.name: Grütschalp
grutschalp.what: Top of the funicular up the cliff. This is why the ticket to ask for is tariff D, the Rundreise.

murren-blm.name: Mürren BLM station
murren-blm.what: Twenty minutes along the cliff shelf with the Jungfrau across the valley. The loveliest flat ride in the Oberland.

murren-schilthornbahn.name: Mürren, Schilthornbahn station
murren-schilthornbahn.what: The other end of the village, which is car-free and worth the walk through. First car up at 07:40.

birg.name: Birg
birg.what: 2,677 m. The Thrill Walk gangway is included and takes 20 minutes - and its floor is open metal grating.

schilthorn.name: Schilthorn, Piz Gloria
schilthorn.what: 2,970 m. The rebuild finished in April 2026, the cars are new, and the revolving restaurant needs a reservation. Last car off the summit 17:50.

gimmelwald.name: Gimmelwald
gimmelwald.what: On the way back down the other side. The cable car stops here whether you want it to or not.

stechelberg-parking.name: Schilthornbahn valley station, Stechelberg
stechelberg-parking.what: The bottom of the other side, and the cheapest car park of the three: CHF 7 for eight hours, open-air, no height limit. Bus 141 back to Lauterbrunnen.

grindelwald-first.name: Grindelwald First
grindelwald-first.what: 2,166 m, 25 minutes up in three stages from the middle of the village. The Cliff Walk at the top is free with the gondola.

bachalpsee.name: Bachalpsee
bachalpsee.what: 3 km each way on a wide, gently rising path, about fifty minutes out. On a still morning the Wetterhorn stands upside down in it.

interlaken-ost.name: Interlaken Ost
interlaken-ost.what: Half an hour down the valley. The Harder Kulm funicular leaves from beside the station and nearby parking is about CHF 10.

harder-kulm.name: Harder Kulm
harder-kulm.what: 1,322 m, ten minutes up, flat at the top, the classic two-lakes view. Runs to 21:10 in September, so it is an evening rather than a day.

zrh-parking3.name: Zurich Airport, Parking 3
zrh-parking3.what: Rental returns, around the clock. The van is due back at 12:00 on the 11th and an hour late can bill as a whole extra day.

zurich-hb.name: Zürich Hauptbahnhof
zurich-hb.what: Thirteen minutes from the airport. Its shops open on Sundays, which almost nothing else in Switzerland does.

zurich-altstadt.name: Zurich Old Town, Lindenhof
zurich-altstadt.what: Flat, paved and small. Lindenhof, the Fraumünster windows, then the lake promenade.

albisguetli.name: Albisgütli, the Knabenschiessen
albisguetli.what: Zurich's own festival, 12-14 September, and the 12th is opening day. Free to walk into and it runs until 01:30. Tram 13 stops short, at Laubegg.

fluelen.name: Flüelen
fluelen.what: Rigi in cloud: boat down the dramatic far end of the lake and back by train, about CHF 27, all of it seated.

blausee.name: Blausee
blausee.what: The washed-out day. A 300 m flat asphalt path from the gate to the water, and the glass-bottomed boat is in the entry price.

oeschinensee.name: Oeschinensee
oeschinensee.what: Turquoise water under the Blüemlisalp walls. The ascent time slot is MANDATORY to 20 September and costs CHF 5 - without it you cannot board.

niesen-kulm.name: Niesen Kulm
niesen-kulm.what: 2,362 m by funicular from Mülenen, thirty minutes. On Wednesday and Friday evenings the last descents run to 23:25, so dinner at the top is possible.

trummelbach.name: Trümmelbach Falls
trummelbach.what: Ten glacier falls inside the mountain, reached by a lift built into the rock - but stairs past halfway and permanently wet, so adults only.

mannlichen-top.name: Männlichen
mannlichen-top.what: A spare day with the parents: gondola up from the Terminal, the almost level Panoramaweg across, cog railway down from Kleine Scheidegg.

kleine-scheidegg.name: Kleine Scheidegg
kleine-scheidegg.what: The far end of the Panoramaweg, and the junction every Jungfrau route passes through.

schynige-platte.name: Schynige Platte
schynige-platte.what: A wet morning: a vintage cog railway from Wilderswil and a free alpine garden with over 750 species, with far fewer people than the famous peaks.
